name: prost
notes: prost with prost-build generated structs (default settings: HashMap maps, Vec<u8> bytes, String strings).
Wire: Message::decode(&[u8]) / Message::encode_to_vec() allocate a new message / Vec per iteration.

prost has no JSON support itself; JSON uses pbjson + pbjson-build generated serde impls (canonical ProtoJSON: lowerCamelCase, 64-bit ints as strings, enums as names, bytes as base64, defaults omitted) driven by serde_json::to_string / serde_json::from_str.
Map iteration order of HashMap is unspecified, so wire_bytes_match may be false for datasets with maps (medium, large); sizes still match.
Build: cargo build --release --locked with the default release profile (no LTO / PGO / target-cpu).
